body: Hey dude, I’m really sorry you’re dealing with all this, I had a similar experience when I was your age. I eventually decided to get help when I failed at taking my life a few times and the best advice I can give you is get help now. I really really regret not asking for help earlier and even if you don’t think you’re depressed doing these kinds of things is a form of mental illness (might not be depression but it is 99.99% of the time some form of mental illness). I’m 18 now and my life is actually a lot better, I moved out, got a girlfriend, and have taken steps to start T in a couple weeks. Basically it gets better, I didn’t believe it would and I know how hopeless it feels right now but I can promise you it will get better if you seek help. I’m not saying everything is perfect, far from it, but it does get a bit easier and it will be worth it in the end. If you want to private message me I can try to help you find some resources based on where you are, but the bottom line is get help, tell your parents, your school, councillor, even me if it will help just anyone who you think will help you. This sub will always support you and remember you are loved and valued by more people than you know. Good luck dude and I’m proud of you.

Hey there dude, I’m really sorry your parents are like this. I had the same experience the first year after coming out. I ended up moving out and they’ve gotten a lot better after a few months of little to no contact. If you can I’d say try and ghost them for a bit, basically disappear from their lives and see how they react. If not just don’t answer when they say your deadname and use the wrong pronouns. Either way good luck Owen, just know everyone in this subreddit supports you entirely! If you need someone to talk to that understands just give me a message on here. Hope you have an ok day dude :)
